name: integration-init
description:
Interactive bootstrap for optional integrations. Asks which tools to add (code-review-graph,
repomix, serena), runs their native installers, configures per-tool mode (MCP / CLI for CRG,
initial build strategy), and injects per-integration documentation into AGENTS.md and
agents/code-reviewer.md via paired markers — only for tools actually installed.
Use when: «init», «initialize toolkit», «set up integrations», «add code-review-graph»,
«add repomix», «add serena», «bootstrap toolkit», «configure integrations».
Idempotent: re-running detects current install state and syncs documentation accordingly.
Run with `--advise-only` for non-mutating dry preview.
compatibility: Claude Code · GitHub Copilot · Cursor v2.2+ · OpenAI Codex CLI · Google Gemini CLI

name: library-audit
description:
Meta-validator for an entire skill library (operates on the collection, not one skill). Runs detect-only phases for handoff contracts, trigger uniqueness, clarification policy, token budget, naming, portability, multi-tool compatibility, security baseline, and metainfo coverage.
Checks include `allowed-tools:`, per-skill `rules/{tool}.md`, required Task/sub-agent dispatch without sequential fallback, secrets, dangerous shell, credential paths, category/tier presence, closed-vocab drift, and deprecation consistency.
Use when: «audit my skills», «audit the library», «library health check», «handoff audit»,
«security audit», «secrets scan». Never edits files, never asks questions, idempotent.
Output: markdown report at `out/library-audit/library-audit-{date}.md` with Category roll-up table.
For per-skill scoring of ONE skill, use `skill-evaluate` (different scope — D1–D9 + per-file lexical scan).
compatibility: Claude Code · GitHub Copilot · Cursor v2.2+ · OpenAI Codex CLI · Google Gemini CLI

name: skill-build-portable
description:
Transforms a non-universal SKILL.md into a universal one that runs across Claude Code, Copilot,
Cursor, Codex, and Gemini without per-tool forking. Audits the source skill for portability
violations (forbidden frontmatter fields, hardcoded org-specific paths, per-skill tool-mapping
files, Claude-only constructs), proposes transformations, generates the portable version,
and shows a side-by-side diff before writing.
Use when: «make this skill portable», «universalize this skill», «convert to universal»,
«portabilize», «refactor for cross-tool», «migrate skill to standard»,
«strip Claude-only fields», «remove allowed-tools».
Output modes: preview (no write) / new-file / in-place. Preserves the skill's functional logic —
only changes structure, frontmatter, and platform-specific constructs. Surfaces residual
concerns the user must review manually.
compatibility: Claude Code · GitHub Copilot · Cursor v2.2+ · OpenAI Codex CLI · Google Gemini CLI

name: skill-compare
description:
Compares a local skill against similar skills in a corporate (or any external) repository to find
overlap, conflicts, and sync opportunities. Use when: «compare these skills», «is there a similar one upstream»,
«check for duplicates», «sync with corporate library», «adopt the shared skill?», «overlap with upstream».
Capabilities: similarity matching across all corporate skills, conflict detection, four-action
recommendation (USE_CORPORATE / KEEP_LOCAL / MERGE / RULES_FILE), automatic generation of
`rules/{project}.md` for project-specific overrides.
compatibility: Claude Code · GitHub Copilot · Cursor v2.2+ · OpenAI Codex CLI · Google Gemini CLI

name: skill-evaluate
description:
Quality evaluator for SKILL.md files. Scores any skill across 9 dimensions:
clarity, completeness, specificity, examples, constraints, portability, testability, discoverability, safety.
Safety (D9) evaluates behavioral risk awareness — blast radius, prompt injection, sensitive data,
authorization, rollback, idempotency. Complements `library-audit` Phase 5 (lexical secrets/dangerous shell).
Use when: «evaluate skill X», «score this skill», «review SKILL.md»,
«is this skill production-ready», «evaluate skill for safety», before merging a new skill or after major rewrites.
Output: dimension table (D1–D9), top-3 specific improvements, optional rewritten version,
and an entry appended to `out/scores/index.jsonl`.
compatibility: Claude Code · GitHub Copilot · Cursor v2.2+ · OpenAI Codex CLI · Google Gemini CLI

name: skill-find
description:
Discovers skills in project / personal / corporate libraries matching a natural-language need.
Use when the user is unsure if a skill exists for their task, asks "is there a skill for...",
or wants to browse available capabilities before creating something new.
Triggers: «is there a skill for X», «find a skill that does Y», «browse skills»,
«what skills handle Z», «do we have a skill for», «search skills».
Returns ranked list with match percentage, quality tier, and next-step recommendation
(use directly / adapt / create new).
compatibility: Claude Code · GitHub Copilot · Cursor v2.2+ · OpenAI Codex CLI · Google Gemini CLI
